affinity.title: Cache-aware routing
affinity.description: Prefer a runtime that may still hold a matching prompt prefix, while letting current load override weak matches.
affinity.privacy: Only tenant-scoped HMAC digests and prompt-free routing metadata are stored. A match predicts cache residency; it does not prove it.

capacity.title: Shared local capacity
capacity.description: Keep pools within the real concurrency and context limits of the runtime they share.
capacity.createDescription: Identify one local runtime and set conservative physical limits. You can attach models after saving.
capacity.editDescription: Update the physical limits and runtime identity used for global admission.
capacity.deleteDescription: This cannot be undone. Attached models must be reassigned before this capacity can be deleted.
capacity.deleteConflict: This capacity is still attached to one or more models. Reassign them and try again.
capacity.typeName: Type the capacity name to confirm
capacity.empty: No shared capacity is configured. Add one before enabling global admission.
capacity.safeDefaults: Start with one concurrent request and a context limit your runtime can reliably serve. Raise limits after observing stable load.
capacity.poolPolicyHint: Set conservative admission behavior across this pool. {{count}} shared capacities are available for member attachment.
capacity.directGlobalEffect: These settings apply to every direct request sent to this execution target, not only this model entry.
capacity.attachmentGlobalEffect: Changing the shared capacity attachment changes admission for this execution target everywhere it is used.
capacity.unlimitedWarning: Unlimited removes a physical safety boundary. Confirm the runtime and provider have an independently enforced ceiling before saving.
capacity.borrowIdle: Borrow only while reserved capacity is idle

strategies.template: Use a matching registered tokenizer and template
strategies.engineRequirement: Requires count-token support on the selected target. WSMP uses a conservative estimate when that support is unavailable.
strategies.registeredRequirement: Requires a registered counter matching this runtime identity. WSMP uses a conservative estimate when no match is available.

pools.protocolCompatibilityHint: Adaptation is opt-in and rejects features outside the documented strict common subset.
pools.addMemberDescription: Add one of your direct discovered models to this pool.
pools.attachmentLimitHint: Leave blank to inherit the global limit. A pool limit cannot exceed it.

wizard.advancedHint: After creation, Advanced setup exposes borrowing, context margins, count strategy, affinity, adaptation, and target ordering.

advanced.title: Advanced capacity, adaptation, and affinity
advanced.capacityDescription: These settings are saved with the pool. The count strategy applies to the selected physical capacities; member overrides remain specific to this pool.
advanced.budgetDescription: Choose LIMITED or UNLIMITED independently for every token and spend period. LIMITED values must be greater than zero.
advanced.budgetWarning: Unlimited rules remove that protective ceiling. Failed or cancelled requests may still incur provider charges, and provider invoices remain authoritative.
advanced.unlimitedWarning: Explicitly unlimited: this protective ceiling is removed.

wizard.capacityHint: These finite defaults protect the physical runtime. Reserved slots stay private to this pool; other idle slots may be borrowed.
wizard.capacityDistinctHint: The existing physical capacity mapping remains unchanged. These pool-member limits separately control how much of that shared capacity this pool may use.
wizard.atomicFailure: Nothing was enabled. Pool setup was rolled back because one or more safeguards could not be created.
wizard.atomicReview: Create {{local}} local member(s) and {{providers}} ordered provider target(s), each with explicit concurrency and a {{spend}} daily spending ceiling.
wizard.atomicRollback: Pool, capacities, members, provider attachments, budgets, and egress activation are committed together. If any step fails, none of them remain enabled.
wizard.description: Choose local capacity first, then explicitly decide whether requests may leave your infrastructure.
wizard.egressRequired: Acknowledge public egress before enabling it.
wizard.egressWarning: When local targets cannot serve a request, its prompts, attachments, tool definitions, and generated output may be sent to the configured public provider.
